title: Maa meri pyaari maa
body:
Maa meri pyaari maa
Ae maa ae maa ae maa pyaari maa..(2)
<<MINI>>
Maa meri pyaari maa pas bula le maa
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Waqt e shahadat aa pohcha hai
khanjar qatil bhi pyasa hai
pyaas bujhane tegh sitam ki
tera lahu maqtal jaata hai
hota hu ghar se rawaa..
<<MINI>>
paas bulale maa
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Tere seene par sar rakh kar
soye hue barso beete hai
god me sou teri jaise
jhule me bache sote hai
chaahiye mujhko amaaan
<<MINI>>
paas bulale maa
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Laasho par laashe laaya hu
maqtal se mai tanha amma
dil me nahi hai taqat mere
uth ta nahi hai sadma amma
khushk hai meri zabaa
<<MINI>>
paas bulale maa
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Chalni hua akbar ka kaleja
seene me toota hai naiza
noor gaya mere ankho ka
milta nahi hai mujhko rasta
margaya kadiyal jawaa
<<MINI>>
paas bulale maa
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Baali sakina rok rahi hai
maqtal me jaane nahi deti
kiske seene par soyegi
amma meri pyaari beti
uspe karo ehsaa
<<MINI>>
paas bulale maa
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Meri behen zainab wo khadi hai
khaime ke dar se dekh rahi hai
sabr khuda de meri behen ko
amma dua do sakht ghadi hai
roti hai sab bibiya
<<MINI>>
paas bulale maa
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Muh ko chupa lo baalo se apne
dekh sakogi kese ye manzar
kese sahogi dekh ke amma
apne pisar ke halq pe khanjar
hota hai khanjar rawa
<<MINI>>
paas bulale maa
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Kehte the farhan ye sarwar
mai to hu rehan e risalat
zakhm hazaro dil pe uthake
karta raha inkare bay'at
ab hai yahi armaa
<<MINI>>
paas bulale maa
maa meri pyaari maa pas bula le maa..(2)
